clip.title: Walking in

clip.title: The hosts at the banner

clip.title: Follow-up from the seats
clip.reason: An audience member gestures back at the presenter - a question caught in the moment, the Q&A thread the event is built on.

clip.title: The room laughs together
clip.reason: The whole room laughs at the presenter's live demo - the warmest, most human moment of the morning and the emotional peak of the cut.

clip.title: The Agent era, on title

clip.reason: The clearest 'big topic' takeaway of the morning - dense Harness tables and architecture diagrams delivered by a speaker the room is quietly locked onto.

clip.title: AI-native tools, on screen
clip.reason: Talk A starts the wider demo run - the room filming the AI-native tools slide with their phones shows genuine interest, not politeness.

clip.title: Audience with a gimbal
clip.reason: A quick audience close-up - people filming and recording, energy in the seats, keeps the cut from becoming only talking heads.

clip.title: A phone chat app, live
clip.reason: A young builder presents his own chat app in his own words with the phone UI on the big screen - a live demo the room can follow.

clip.title: A woman demos her phone app
clip.reason: A woman presents her own phone app with the springboard screen behind her - an everyday build, told in her own words in front of the room.

clip.title: Your agents work
clip.reason: A woman presents her agents product ('Your brand knows more than it remembers' on screen) to a full table of listeners - a clear, confident pitch.

clip.title: Live code, CREWCLAW
clip.reason: A terminal on the big screen and a room smiling - the demo is landing in real time, with the presenter front-facing and engaged.

clip.title: Information Radar
clip.reason: A builder shows his AI-news dashboard (GitHub trending, tool rankings, a China map of AI activity) - a practical tool the room is filming with a phone.

clip.title: Your agents work while you sleep

clip.title: A question at the ARIAVA screen
clip.reason: An audience member points at the ARIAVA QR screen with a question - the thread being caught on the product side of the room.

clip.title: Chatting under the plane trees
clip.reason: A breather outside - four people talking over drinks under the plane trees, the relaxed daily-life register that frames the whole event.

clip.title: Sign-off at the banner
clip.reason: Close on the wide shot at the Cursor x Sunset Shanghai banner with people by the door - the day ends where it began, outside the cafe.
